# Lyrd

Lyrd is a React runtime for modal interaction. It manages app-defined Alert and Confirm recipes,
custom JSX sessions, Promise results, close lifecycle, and a shared LIFO stack. The application owns
request fields, JSX, styling, copy, and UI primitive adapters.

Documentation: https://seunjin.github.io/lyrd/
Complete agent documentation: https://seunjin.github.io/lyrd/llms-full.txt
Integration test prompt: https://seunjin.github.io/lyrd/agent-test-prompt.md
Repository: https://github.com/seunjin/lyrd
Packages: @lyrd/core and @lyrd/cli

## Start here

1. Run `pnpm dlx @lyrd/cli add overlay --verbose` to generate an app-owned scope, Provider, and Base UI renderers.
2. Mount the generated Provider once and import `useOverlay` from the generated app module.
3. Use `alert()` for one synchronous acknowledgement action.
4. Use `confirm()` for boolean choice and optional sync or async `onConfirm` work.
5. Use `open<Result>(<Component />)` for Dialog, Sheet, BottomSheet, Drawer, and fullscreen modal UI.
6. Treat JSX props as a call-time snapshot; keep changing state inside the open component or an external store/query.
7. Use `overlay.close()` for the topmost session, `handle.close()` for one exact session, and `closeAll()` for all sessions.
8. Connect `requestClose()` to ESC/outside attempts and `completeClose()` to the end of exit animation.

Toast and non-modal notifications are outside Lyrd Core and CLI. Use only the documented modal APIs.
